title: Generated Image API
description: API-backed generated still provider. Secret values remain machine-local and are resolved only through the symbolic api_key_env reference.

api_endpoint.title: API endpoint
api_endpoint.description: HTTPS image-generation endpoint. Loopback HTTP is accepted only for local testing.

api_key_env.title: API key environment variable
api_key_env.description: Name of the machine-local environment variable containing the API key. The secret value is never stored in OmniCreator portable data.

model.title: Provider model
model.description: Provider-specific model identity kept inside the plugin configuration boundary.

model_version.title: Model version / revision
model_version.description: Provider revision recorded in safe provenance and verified by core.
